title: Missing Person — Madison Fields (16, Colerain OH)
summary: Madison Fields, 16, missing from Colerain, OH since Feb 13, 2026. Last seen on foot leaving InTown Suites after 4 p.m. Was reportedly going to meet 'Josh', a Session app contact. Federal investigation established Kyle D. Lawrence (43, Buffalo NY) had grooming contact via Snapchat and met Madison in Cincinnati twice in January; Lawrence arrested Feb 26 on federal exploitation charges. Madison remains missing; 'Josh' identity unresolved.

evidence.description: Official Endangered Missing Child Alert issued by the Ohio Attorney General. Subject: Madison Fields, 16. Last seen Feb 13 ~4pm at Harry Lee Lane, Colerain OH. Includes physical description and clothing.
evidence.ai_summary: AG-issued alert. Madison Fields, 16, 5'4", 127 lbs, brown hair, green eyes. Last seen Feb 13 4pm leaving Harry Lee Lane area on foot, wearing black Champion hooded sweatshirt, camo pants, black shoes, black backpack, carrying a white grocery bag.

evidence.evidence_name: DOJ Press Release — Lawrence Federal Charges
evidence.description: U.S. Attorney's Office, Southern District of Ohio press release. Kyle D. Lawrence, 43, of Buffalo, NY, arrested Feb 26 on federal sexual exploitation charges. Details Snapchat communication, two Cincinnati hotel visits in January, prior NCMEC cyber tips, and May 2024 Canada incident.
evidence.ai_summary: Federal charges: transportation with intent (10-life), travel with intent (up to 30y), transportation of CSAM (5-20y). License plate readers + receipts confirm Lawrence rented a black Jeep Grand Cherokee with NY plates and stayed at a Cincinnati hotel with Madison on Jan 31. Search warrant Feb 26 recovered electronic devices containing CSAM.

leads.title: Forensic extraction of Session app on any devices linked to Madison
leads.description: Session is end-to-end encrypted and metadata-stripping at the network layer, but on-device databases retain message content. If Madison's phone is recovered, Cellebrite extraction will surface Josh's messages, timestamps, and possible identifiers.
action_items: Issue BOLO for Madison's phone (model/IMEI from family).
Coordinate with FBI digital forensics on Cellebrite extraction priority.
Subpoena Session if a server-side identifier exists for the contact.

leads.title: Subpoena Snapchat for full account history on Lawrence's account
leads.description: Lawrence admits to using Snapchat to communicate with Madison and Snap Map to locate her. Snapchat retains account metadata, login IPs, and chat content per their LE retention policy. Subpoena will establish full contact timeline and may surface additional victims.
action_items: Draft federal subpoena via AUSA Healey (Southern District of Ohio).
Request: account creation date, all chats, Snap Map history, login IPs.
Cross-reference Snap Map IPs against LPR data on the Jeep.

leads.title: Pull and review InTown Suites surveillance Feb 13, 1500-1800
leads.description: Surveillance captured Madison's exit on foot. Need full hotel + perimeter coverage during the 3-hour window to identify any vehicle approach, third party, or directional change. Compare with Harry Lee Lane camera windows.
action_items: Request InTown Suites DVR copy (last seen window + 1hr).
Identify ANY vehicle that idled or arrived in the lot 15:30-17:00.
Cross-check against the Jan 31 hotel lot footage if obtainable.

leads.title: Identify the unknown commenter on Madison's birthday post
leads.description: Birthday post (IMG_5382) contains a comment from a username that does not match any known classmate or family contact per the agent's cross-check. Could be a Josh-related account or a benign acquaintance.
action_items: Pull username from IMG_5382 OCR + screenshot.
Run reverse-image search and Snapchat/Session handle correlation.
Issue Instagram preservation request if username cannot be resolved.

leads.description: Family supplied a photo identifying a separate biological father. His relationship to Madison and any recent contact is unknown. Rule in or out as a relevant party.
action_items: Interview Tyler Hirn re: bio father identity, custody history.
Pull court records for any custody / visitation orders.

leads.title: Pull FBI Buffalo file on Lawrence's May 2024 Canada incident

action_items: Request FBI Buffalo case file via AUSA channel.
Identify the vigilante group and the original 15yo identity.
Determine whether any travel records intersect with Madison's known timeline.

hypotheses.statement: 'Josh' (Session contact) is the same person as Kyle D. Lawrence.
hypotheses.reasoning: Both subjects were grooming the same 16-year-old in overlapping windows. Lawrence used Snapchat; 'Josh' used Session. The simplest explanation is that the same offender used multiple platforms — but Lawrence was in federal custody from Feb 26, and 'Josh' contact dates extend through Feb 13. Plausible but not strongly supported.

hypotheses.statement: 'Josh' is a separate offender, possibly connected to Lawrence as a co-conspirator or referral.
hypotheses.reasoning: Two independent offenders contacting the same minor in overlapping windows is statistically unusual. Lawrence's January visits + 'Josh's Feb 13 meeting create a 13-day gap that could indicate referral or coordinated activity. Session is favored by traffickers because it strips metadata.

hypotheses.statement: The 3-day reporting delay (Feb 13 → Feb 16) materially worsened the search outcome.
hypotheses.reasoning: Madison was last seen Feb 13. Family did not contact police until Feb 16 because father believed she was at Lily's house. Loss of phone signal Feb 13 evening + 3-day delay limited geolocation and surveillance windows. AG alert did not issue until Feb 20 — 7 days post-disappearance.
